messages:
maya: Heads-up 1 launch surge plan for the inference webinar. Need a short battlecard, two LP hero lines, and a one-click lead-route spec for SDRs. Can we lock by EOD? :alarm_clock:
raj: I'll run p50/p95 + cost/1k for chat (2k ctx) and embeddings (batch64). Will include quant & batching notes. ETA 2pm.
tori: I'll add warm vs cold tail and a small callout on caching priming.
sam: Routing proposal: form emits hidden fields -> webinar_signal, region, lead_intent. Rules: hot->AE immediate, warm->SDR sequence, cold->drip. Can we make webhook POST JSON?
jordan: Yes. I'll add hidden inputs and POST to /hooks/lead-route. Test payload: {"webinar_signal":"1","region":"EU","lead_intent":"hot"}. Need final field names.
maya: Hero line candidates: 1) "Production-first controls that cut unit cost and tame latency" 2) "Same serving API across hosted 1 dedicated 1 private". Use "up to" for percents and link to appendix.
sdr-ops-bot: Reminder: update Marketo mapping & SDR playbook by 09:00 tomorrow.
maya: I'll draft a two-page battlecard (top objections + quick rebuttals vs cloud vendors & infra vendors) and drop it for review at 4:30. If no blockers we'll push LP copy and the webhook to staging tonight. :rocket:
